columns.comment: Durable golden client id from entity resolution (GC-nnnnnn), stable across ER runs and SCD2 versions; one golden client = one resolved legal entity.
columns.name: golden_client_id

columns.comment: Score date (daily, including weekends); 30-Sep-2026 = today.
columns.name: score_date

columns.comment: Surrogate key of the dim_client version valid on this row's date (SCD2 as-was join, D11); join to gold.dim_client.golden_client_sk for the client attributes at that time.
columns.name: golden_client_sk

columns.comment: Client group (global parent group) id from the Tokyo HO group master (SYN-G-nnnn); join to gold.dim_client_group.
columns.name: client_group_id

columns.comment: Credit obligor record whose score is shown (the worst of the day when the client has duplicate credit records).
columns.name: obligor_id

columns.comment: Credit obligor records of the client scored that day (normally 1).
columns.name: n_obligors_scored

columns.comment: Composite EWS score 0-100 (higher = riskier); point-in-time - average or take the latest, never sum.
columns.name: composite_score

columns.comment: Model band from the composite score before overrides: Green (< 40), Amber (40-69) or Red (>= 70).
columns.name: computed_band

columns.comment: Final EWS band after steward overrides - the band to report (Green, Amber, Red).
columns.name: final_band

columns.comment: Final band on the previous day (null on the first scored day).
columns.name: prev_final_band

columns.comment: Model band on the previous day.
columns.name: prev_computed_band

columns.comment: True when the final band differs from the previous day's.
columns.name: final_band_changed

columns.comment: Band move on this day, e.g. Green to Amber, Amber to Red (null when unchanged).
columns.name: band_change

columns.comment: True on the day the final band moved from Green to Amber.
columns.name: moved_green_to_amber

columns.comment: True on the day the final band entered Red from Green or Amber.
columns.name: entered_red

columns.comment: Final band 30 days earlier (null in the first 30 days of the series).
columns.name: final_band_30d_ago

columns.comment: True when the final band is Amber today but was Green 30 days earlier - robust to day-to-day flicker; use on the as-of date for clients that moved Green to Amber in the last 30 days.
columns.name: moved_green_to_amber_30d

columns.comment: Composite score 30 days earlier.
columns.name: score_30d_ago

columns.comment: Composite score change over 30 days (points; positive = deteriorating).
columns.name: score_change_30d

columns.comment: Consecutive days the client has been in the current final band up to this day (counted from 1-Apr-2025 at the earliest).
columns.name: days_in_final_band

columns.comment: True when the final band differs from the model band (an override changed the band).
columns.name: is_band_overridden

columns.comment: True when a steward override is in force on the day (including overrides that affirm the model band).
columns.name: is_overridden

columns.comment: True on the day an override was made or re-confirmed (count these for 'overrides this year').
columns.name: override_event_flag

columns.comment: Override in force (EWS-OVR-...); null when none.
columns.name: override_id

columns.comment: Date the override in force was made / re-confirmed.
columns.name: override_date

columns.comment: Override direction: Soften (band lowered), Escalate (band raised) or Affirm.
columns.name: override_direction

columns.comment: Model band the steward overrode at the override date.
columns.name: override_model_band

columns.comment: Override rationale, e.g. Parent support confirmed (JP data): keepwell from the Japanese parent ...
columns.name: override_reason

columns.comment: Credit steward who made the override (name as recorded by the EWS engine).
columns.name: override_analyst_name

columns.comment: Evidence reference of the override, e.g. the JP-share support letter id (JPSL-...).
columns.name: override_evidence_ref

columns.comment: True when the override cites parent support confirmed from Japan (JP share data).
columns.name: is_parent_support_override

columns.comment: True when the override in force was confirmed on a day the JP share feed it relies on was stale (refresh lag > 24h in the share refresh log) - audit flag.
columns.name: source_data_stale

columns.comment: Credit sub-score 0-100 (health, utilisation, covenant).
columns.name: credit_component

columns.comment: Liquidity sub-score 0-100 (deposit outflow).
columns.name: liquidity_component

columns.comment: Behavioural sub-score 0-100 (payments routed to other banks).
columns.name: behavioural_component

columns.comment: External sub-score 0-100 from news sentiment - informational, not part of the composite.
columns.name: external_component

columns.comment: Strongest trigger fired in the score's month (most score points, then severity); join to gold.dim_ews_trigger.
columns.name: top_trigger_1

columns.comment: Second trigger of the month.
columns.name: top_trigger_2

columns.comment: Third trigger of the month.
columns.name: top_trigger_3

columns.comment: Top three triggers of the month as text, e.g. COV_BREACH, UTIL_HIGH, DPD_30.
columns.name: top_triggers_text

columns.comment: Triggers fired for the client in the score's month.
columns.name: n_triggers_month

columns.comment: True when the client is on the credit watchlist on the day (watchlist register membership).
columns.name: is_watchlisted

columns.comment: Client's drawn lending exposure at the month-end of the score month, USD - 'exposure' (point-in-time: sum across clients on one day, never across days).
columns.name: exposure_drawn_usd

columns.comment: Client's committed facility limits at the month-end of the score month, USD.
columns.name: exposure_limit_usd

columns.comment: Client's exposure at default for the score month, USD (from Apr-2024; null when not computed).
columns.name: ead_usd

columns.comment: Client's expected credit loss provision (IFRS 9) for the score month, USD.
columns.name: ecl_usd

columns.comment: True on calendar month-ends (use for month-end snapshots, e.g. exposure in Amber / Red at each month-end).
columns.name: is_month_end

columns.comment: True on 30-Sep-2026 (today).
columns.name: is_as_of_date

comment: Daily early-warning score per client (brief 5.4), 1-Apr-2025 to 30-Sep-2026, every calendar day: composite EWS score 0-100 = 1.12 x 100 x (0.45 credit-health + 0.20 utilisation + 0.15 covenant + 0.12 deposit-outflow + 0.08 wallet-leakage stress), the model (computed) band and the final band after steward overrides (Green < 40, Amber 40-69, Red >= 70), previous band, band change (e.g. Green to Amber), band 30 days ago, days in the current band, override flags (override in force, override event day, parent-support override, source_data_stale = override confirmed while the JP share feed was stale), the four explainable sub-components (external = news, informational only), the top three triggers of the month, the watchlist flag and the client's month-end exposure / EAD / ECL. Scores and exposure are point-in-time: never sum across days; count clients per day or take the latest day (score_date = 30-Sep-2026 is today). Grain: one row per golden client x score date.
